customManagers.description: Track CPython for THIS REPO's line. One repo ships one line, so the cap keeps it on 3.15.x: Python 3.16 arrives as a new repo.

packageRules.description: The 315 line stays on 3.15.x. Not an automerge exception -- automerge is the family default (ship-if-green) and still applies; this only stops Renovate from walking the line onto a Python minor it was never built for.
